name: specialist-card
title: Specialist card
description: A person you can book: photo, name, specialties, languages, rating and the next free slot in words, with a book action kept apart from the profile link.
docs: name is the one link of the card (href, with onOpen for a client-side router; without an href but with onOpen it becomes a button) and the Book button (onBook) is its own target above it, named with the person. image falls back to initials, taken from the name without the titles in front of it ('Dr. Ines Kowalski' is IK) or from initials when you give them. rating and ratingCount draw the stars to the exact average and are read as a sentence ('Rated 4.9 out of 5 from 128 reviews'); a count of zero says 'No reviews yet'. specialties and languages are word chips under their own labels. nextAvailable is an exact moment, written the way a person says it ('Today, 16:45', 'Tomorrow, 10:30', 'Thursday, 14:15', then '12 Nov, 09:00') in a time element, counted in timeZone against now: leave now out to use the browser's clock after the first paint, and until then the slot is written as a date so the server and the browser agree. null says 'No slots this week' and disables Book (aria-disabled, described by that line); leave it out to show no slot at all. labels carries every word.
